{{Quote|Into the Depths of Eternity, if you sink into that, even we cannot pull you back|[[Feryl]] to the Skywalkers while [[Beyond shadows]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Abyss">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]''</ref>}}
The '''Depths of Eternity''' was the bottom of the [[Lake of Apparitions]], a lake found [[beyond shadows]], a realm of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] which [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] entered after separating their minds from their physical beings. When walking across the lake beings had to stay on a set path, or they would fall into the Depths of Eternity, a fall from which they could not be saved or retrieved.

[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], traveled to [[Sinkhole Station]] in search of the [[Mind Walkers]] in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]]. The Mind Walkers took them beyond shadows, where eventually they found the Lake of Apparitions. While crossing the lake, Luke stumbled, causing his whole leg to go underwater. When Ben looked to see the cause, he saw his father had stumbled at the sight of [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] floating on the surface.

Later, both Skywalkers [[Mind Walking|Mind Walked]] there again, along with [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Leeha Faal]]. Faal was dragged down into the Depths by long-dead enemies, which caused her physical body to spasm violently and then die.
